ui.panel.marketplace.dialog_install.repl: {repository} uses the {domain} domain, which belongs to an integration that comes with Home Assistant. After a restart, Home Assistant loads this one instead of the built-in integration, for everything you set up with it. Devices and services you already set up may stop working. Fixes and improvements to the built-in integration no longer reach you with Home Assistant updates, and the Home Assistant project cannot help with problems it causes. To go back to the built-in integration, uninstall it and restart Home Assistant.
